text:
Morgan - People Ops: quick one from Jamal: manager wants an out-of-cycle salary bump + title for a new hire, with an effective date of 2026-03-01 even though the employee's start is 2026-03-11. they want payroll to avoid complex backpay. what do we need to accept an earlier effective date? cc @Priya @Elena

Jamal - Eng Manager: exact ask: salary + seniority bump (SWE II -> SWE III) effective 3/1. Candidate accepted offer verbally 2/20, signed offer lists start 3/11. Manager prefers retro date 3/1.

Elena - Comp Analyst: considerations: 1) salary can be backdated in many jurisdictions but we need a signed amendment that explicitly sets the effective date; 2) equity/grant docs should not be backdated if that changes eligibility/vesting; 3) comp team will prepare a backpay calc and document assumptions.

Priya - Payroll: operational notes: payroll can process a manual adjustment for March if we have all paperwork before the cutoff (2026-03-25 23:59 PST). We need: signed amendment, comp-approved backpay amount, a payroll reason code, and country tax memo if EMEA. Our manual adjustment flow:

```
# payroll ops example
create_adjustment --eid 004321 --period 2026-03 --retro_start 2026-03-01 --amount 1250.00 --reason "OC comp increase effective 3/1"
```

Do not run until People Ops confirms docs. Also note: some EU countries won't accept pay for periods before hire — legal must confirm.

Alex - HRBP: benefits can't be retro-enrolled. Enrollment start remains hire date (3/11). Communicate to manager that benefits coverage won't start earlier. Title change is fine to reflect in HRIS effective 3/1 if docs allow, but again legal check for local requirements.

Lena - Legal (EMEA): for most EMEA countries we need the employee to be on payroll to remit taxes for earlier periods. If the employee wasn't on payroll on 3/1, we may need to treat the amount as a one-time sign-on payment tied to the hire date. Send country and contract details and we can advise. Also: ensure amendment language includes tax liability acknowledgement.

Jamal - Eng Manager: understood. I'll attach the signed amendment (manager + candidate) and the original offer statement. Quick question on backpay math: do we prorate by actual calendar days pre-start or pay full month if effective is 3/1?

Elena - Comp Analyst: we prorate by days unless comp policy specifies full-month credit on effective date. Standard formula we use is:

```
backpay = ((new_annual - old_annual) / 365) * days_prior
```

where days_prior = number of days between effective_date and hire_date (exclusive of hire day if hiring day is fully paid by new salary). Example: effective 3/1, start 3/11 => days_prior = 10 (3/1-3/10).

Priya - Payroll: also check gross-to-net and tax withholding implications; payroll will generate a tax memo. Large retro amounts may push social/tax bands; we might split the adj across runs if needed.

Morgan - People Ops: checklist I'll track: 1) Jamal uploads signed amendment to the candidate file and pings this thread. 2) Elena posts backpay calc + equity note. 3) Alex + Lena confirm EMEA tax/contract constraints. 4) Priya confirms final run command + cutoff compliance. 5) People Ops files final package and authorizes payroll run.
